# Time-boxed catalogue research

The schema and seed owner performs this step; there is no separate sourcing agent or handoff. Spend **at most 10 minutes total** checking a few examples of product families, descriptions, units and approximate prices. Stop at the limit; use plausible synthetic assumptions for gaps. No CSV, evidence ledger, research report or family-rules document is required.

Generate the catalogue offline from deterministic family-specific templates and fixed random inputs. Use visibly synthetic generated part numbers and illustrative prices; do not imply generated identities or prices are verified. Preserve `MAT-000123`, its SKF identity and synthetic `19.95` price, `MAT-000124`, and the combined Brisbane bearing cohort. Record any sources actually used briefly in seed comments or handoff notes. State in the README that the generated catalogue and prices are illustrative.
